summary: 昆士兰蔗农一面承受糖价低迷，一面要为减少农田径流和水土流失投入资金。有人设法让糖厂转产高附加值食品，有人靠兼业支撑，坚持种蔗也与他们珍惜的家庭生活方式有关。
logic: 糖价下跌迫使部分种植户退出
糖厂探索食品加工转型
农户投入资金防止径流和侵蚀
收入与生活方式左右去留

paragraphs.brief: 昆士兰州的澳大利亚莫斯曼镇位于雨林和大堡礁之间的热带地貌。
sentences: Problems in the Australian sugar industry The Australian town of Mossman in the state of Queensland sits in a tropical landscape between the rainforest and the Great Barrier Reef.
昆士兰州的澳大利亚莫斯曼镇位于雨林和大堡礁之间的热带地貌。
Eco-tourism is important there; more than 80 per cent of Douglas Shire, of which Mossman is the administrative centre, is protected by World Heritage listing.
生态旅游在这方面很重要；80%以上的Douglas Shire(Mossman是其中的行政中心)受到世界遗产清单的保护。
But for most of the town’s history, forest and reef have been largely irrelevant: since the sugar mill was built in 1894, the town has relied on sugarcane.
但对于该镇的大部分历史来说，森林和珊瑚礁基本上无关紧要：自从糖厂建于1894年以来，该镇一直依赖甘蔗。
Now Mossman is holding its breath.
现在摩斯曼屏住呼吸
For two years the mill used by all the farms has been close to bankruptcy.
两年来，所有农场使用的磨坊几乎破产。

It is at the centre of the economic shocks that have shaken Australia’s sugar industry, and for lifetime farmers and a long list of cane-industry workers a way of life will disappear if the mill closes.
这也是澳大利亚糖业经济冲击的核心，对于终身农民和大量甘蔗工业工人来说，如果磨坊关闭，生活方式就会消失。
Mossman has roughly 160 growers, who now produce less than one million tonnes of the nation’s annual cane harvest of 30–40 million tonnes.
莫斯曼约有 160 户种植者。全国每年收获 3,000 万至 4,000 万吨甘蔗，其中他们如今生产的不到 100 万吨。
But it is a microcosm of the industry.
但它是工业的缩影。
All across Australia, the cane-growing business is being squeezed between the pincers of economics and the environment.
在澳大利亚各地，种植甘蔗的企业被挤压在经济和环境的夹缝之间。

paragraphs.brief: 在整个1990年代，种植糖者的十年平均收益约为每吨350美元。
sentences: The ten-year average return to sugar growers throughout the 1990s was about $350 a tonne.
在整个1990年代，种植糖者的十年平均收益约为每吨350美元。
In early 2004, sugar prices plummeted, resulting in a 25-year-low average price for Australian sugar of about $232 a tonne.
2004年初，糖价暴跌，导致澳大利亚糖的平均价格低25年，每吨约232美元。
Although figures vary widely across farms and regions, that was about what it cost to grow a tonne of sugar in Australia.
虽然不同农场和地区的数字差别很大，但澳大利亚种植一吨糖的成本却很大。
To forestall social and economic disaster, the Government offered more than $400 million to encourage growers to leave the industry.
为了预防社会和经济灾难，政府提供了4亿多美元，鼓励种植者离开该行业。

By the end of the year, 21 farmers had taken up the offer to leave, but another 1 000 are thought to be seriously considering it, allowing those remaining to buy the vacated land and improve their economies of scale.
到年底，21名农民接受了离开的提议，但据认为另有1 000名农民正在认真考虑这一提议，允许其余农民购买空出的土地，改善规模经济。

paragraphs.brief: 第四代摩斯曼种植者比尔・菲利普斯・特纳是计划继续战斗的人
sentences: Fourth-generation Mossman grower Bill Phillips-Turner is one who plans to fight on.
第四代摩斯曼种植者比尔・菲利普斯・特纳是计划继续战斗的人
‘The consequences of losing the mill would be catastrophic,’ Bill says.
比尔说，“失去磨坊的后果将是灾难性的”。
‘Sugar has a big economic multiplier effect: for every dollar generated from sugar, an additional $7 is generated in the wider community.
糖具有巨大的经济倍增效应：每1美元糖产生，在更广泛的社区产生7美元。
Because of limited options around here, most people now employed by the industry would have to leave the area to find work.’
因为这里的选择有限，多数现受雇于工业的人不得不离开该地区找工作。
The farmer-shareholders have so far saved the mill by accepting substantial cuts to cane payments, but this has come at a big cost to everyone.
农民分享土地迄今通过接受大幅削减甘蔗付款而挽救了磨坊，但这样做给每个人带来巨大代价。
As chairman of the board of the mill, Bill has presided over some tough and unpopular decisions; the hardest was slashing the mill workforce.
比尔作为磨坊理事会主席，主持了一些艰难和不受欢迎的决定；最困难的是裁剪磨坊的劳动力。
Assets were sold and maintenance costs cut.
出售了资产，并削减了维修费用。
The board has also worked hard to find new ways of doing business.
董事会还努力寻找新的经营方式。
Ethanol production, where sugar is used to produce fuel, has potential, and co-generation, using cane waste to generate electric power, is another possibility.
使用糖生产燃料的乙醇生产具有潜力，使用甘蔗废物产生电能的共生是另一种可能性。
However, the most radical—but preferred—alternative is to create a future for the mill as a food factory, turning out quality sugar-based foods.
然而，最激进但更可取的替代办法是为面粉厂创造未来，使之成为一个食品工厂，生产出优质的食糖食品。

paragraphs.brief: 除了经济斗争之外，还有环境斗争。
sentences: In addition to the economic struggle, there is the environmental one.
除了经济斗争之外，还有环境斗争。
The sugar industry has the reputation of being environmentally damaging, but it has some surprising supporters.
制糖业的声誉是对环境有害的，但它有一些令人惊讶的支持者。
Douglas Shire mayor, Mike Berwick, is a well-known environmentalist and might be expected to be anti-cane.
道格拉斯·希尔市长迈克·贝威克是一位著名的环保主义者，可能被认为具有反气候的性质。
‘There’s no question of the past damage it’s done to the reef through chemical and nutrient run-off*,’ he says.
他说：“没有任何问题过去的损害它已经对珊瑚礁通过化学和养分径流。”
‘But there’s a formula for sustainable cane production and Mossman has nearly reached it.’
"但是有一个可持续的甘蔗生产公式摩斯曼已经接近它。"
Another surprise endorsement for cane comes from the Queensland Environmental Protection Agency’s sugar liaison officer, Karen Benn.
昆士兰环境保护署的糖业联络员Karen Benn对甘蔗又表示惊讶。
‘I’m less worried about the effect of cane on the environment than I am about other agriculture,’ she says.
她说：“我对甘蔗对环境的影响比对其它农业更不担心。”
‘There are good growers everywhere, but at Mossman they seem to have taken up the challenges faster.’
“各地都有好种植者，但在莫斯曼，他们似乎较快地接受了挑战。”

For example, sediment run-off, previously one of the main environmental problems caused by cane growing, is now nothing like it once was, according to Dr Brian Roberts, co-ordinator of the Douglas Shire Water Quality Improvement Program.
例如，先前由甘蔗生长引起的主要环境问题之一的沉积物径流现在与过去完全不同，据Douglas Shire水质改善方案协调员Brian Roberts博士说。
‘North Queensland used to hold the record for soil loss,’ he says.
他说，“北昆士兰州曾经记录着土壤流失情况”。
‘Now … cane country is accumulating soil.’
"现在... 甘蔗国家正在积累土壤。"

paragraphs.brief: 这种对生活方式的嗜好使许多甘蔗农种植的作物表现不佳
sentences: However, these improvements have been achieved at a great cost to growers.
然而，这些改善是以种植者付出巨大代价取得的。
Now in his 60s, Tom Watters has spent a lifetime on the same farm.
汤姆·沃特斯60多岁时曾经在同一农场度过一生

Fourteen years ago, he was alerted to the effect his cane could be having on Mackay Creek, the narrow waterway that receives all his run-off, and so Tom planted a 5 000-tree buffer along the edge of the creek, built up the edges of the creek with rocks to prevent erosion, and began exploring farming methods that cause minimal soil disturbance.
14年前，他被提醒他的手杖可能会对麦凯溪产生影响，这条狭窄的水道接收了他的所有径流，所以汤姆在溪边种植了五千棵树缓冲剂，用岩石建造小溪边缘，以防止侵蚀，并开始探索导致最小程度土壤扰动的农耕方法。
However, none of these costly initiatives has helped him get better cane prices.
然而，这些代价高昂的举措都未能帮助他获得更好的甘蔗价格。
Another cane grower, Doug Crees, comments that ‘Economically, it [cane growing] doesn’t make much sense.
另一个甘蔗种植者，Doug Crees，评论说，“从经济角度讲，它[生长并没有什么意义。
But there’s more to life than money.’
但生活比金钱还重要。
It’s this addiction to the way of life that keeps many cane farmers growing an underperforming crop.
这种对生活方式的嗜好使许多甘蔗农种植的作物表现不佳
‘It’s a good lifestyle,’ Doug says.
道格说：「这是好生活方式。
‘I spend eight months working on the farm and four months looking after our kids while my wife works in town.
我花了八个月在农场工作四个月照顾我们的孩子而我的妻子在城里工作。
I’ve been looking at alternative crops, like forestry and cocoa, and it turns out that working away from the farm is the best diversification we could do.
我研究过其他作物，例如林业和可可，结果发现离开农场工作是我们所能做的最好的多样化。
However, I still don’t want to do that.’
不过，我还是不想这样做。"

paragraphs.brief: 一个多世纪以来，甘蔗农一直是东昆士兰州的一部分，但尽管他们努力与良好的环境斗争，但不能保证那里正在演变的新的生活方式将包括甘蔗。
sentences: It is difficult to see how anyone can deal satisfactorily with the passing of a way of life.
很难想象任何人如何令人满意地处理生活方式的传承。

Cane farmers have been part of eastern Queensland for more than a century, but despite the efforts they have put into fighting the good environmental fight, there is no guarantee that the new way of life evolving there will include cane.
一个多世纪以来，甘蔗农一直是东昆士兰州的一部分，但尽管他们努力与良好的环境斗争，但不能保证那里正在演变的新的生活方式将包括甘蔗。

items.en: Mossman cane-farming practices are close to an environmentally friendly model.
items.zh: 莫斯曼甘蔗种植做法接近于一种无害环境的模式。

items.en: Financial return is not the only important factor for cane growers.
items.zh: 经济回报不是种植甘蔗者的唯一重要因素。

items.en: Cane sugar may not harm the environment as much as other crops do.
items.zh: 甘蔗糖可能不会像其他作物一样对环境造成危害。

items.en: The local population would decline if the sugar-processing plant closed.
items.zh: 如果糖厂关闭，当地人口将下降。

items.en: In the first paragraph, the writer says that the town is ‘holding its breath’ because
items.zh: 在第一段，作者说，该镇正在`屏息 '，因为
correct: a key processing plant may shut down.

items.en: According to the writer, cane growers who refuse the Government offer are expected to
items.zh: 据作者说，甘蔗种植者拒绝政府的提议，预计

items.en: Which of the following did Bill Phillips-Turner find most difficult to do?
items.zh: Bill Phillips -Turner觉得最难做到的是什么？
correct: cut the number of mill staff
削减面粉厂工作人员人数

items.en: Cane grower Doug Crees says that he
items.zh: 肯恩种植者道格·克里斯说
correct: wants to remain on his farm.

items.en: In 2004, the cost of producing sugar in Australia was similar to the selling price.
items.zh: 2004年，澳大利亚的制糖成本与销售价格相似。
items.why: 2004年每吨糖的售价约等于澳大利亚农民种出一吨糖的成本。

items.en: Farmers who accepted the Government offer have mostly moved to the city.
items.zh: 接受政府提议的农民大多迁往城市。
items.why: 政府出资鼓励农户退出行业，文章没有说明接受补偿者后来多数迁往哪里。

items.en: Fuel production is regarded as the most desirable alternative business for the sugar mill.
items.zh: 燃料生产被视为糖厂最可取的替代业务。
items.why: 文中首选蔡代方案是“食品工厂”,并非“燃料生产”(乙醇)。陈述与原文相反。

items.en: Tom Watters reduced his use of pesticides.
items.zh: 汤姆・沃特斯减少了杀虫剂的使用
items.why: 沃特斯种树、加固河岸并寻找少扰动土壤的耕作方法，没有提到减少杀虫剂用量。

items.en: Environmentally friendly farming practices have been profitable for Tom Watters.
items.zh: 环境友好型耕作方法对Tom Watters有利可图。
items.why: 友好型做法并未带来更高收益，题干说“带来盈利" 与原文相反。

points: 沃特斯种树、加固河岸并寻找少扰动土壤的耕作方法，没有提到减少杀虫剂用量。
题干问“甘蔗糖可能不会像其他作物一样对环境造成危害”。定位句写到“她说：“我对甘蔗对环境的影响比对其它农业更不担心。””。
clauses: “who now produce less than one million tonnes of the nation’s annual cane harvest of 30–40 million tonnes”修饰前面的 growers。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 who 时，回看 growers，再把修饰信息接回主句。
…, that was about what it cost to grow a tonne of sugar in Australia.
连接词 although 引出“Although figures vary widely across farms and regions”，说明主句的让步关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 although 把这一层关系补进去。
